title: current peer-operation matrix and provenance-centered ACIS kernel screen
mode: primary-source repository/documentation and local plan-owner review
scope: Refresh current open-source DWG/DXF route declarations and operation-specific caveats
Screen current OpenCADKernel source for ACIS/B-rep preservation architecture and evidence maturity
Reconcile peer-only reports with existing local plan owners without importing peer defects as local findings
Refine the composed modeler-carrier evidence tuple and output disposition policy
Preserve the reduced fast-test cadence, fixture policy, and external qualification boundaries

sources.name: OpenCADKernel current README
sources.observed: The repository describes itself as early and says most operations are not yet implemented. It outlines an ACIS lift/lower feature, source-record provenance and dirty tracking, and replay of original bytes for untouched nodes. The ACIS feature depends on opencadcodec. The repository page lists no release. Treat this as a preservation-design candidate only; source claims were not executed.

sources.name: ACadRust current README and OpenCADStudio consumer lineage
sources.observed: The current README declares ASCII/binary DXF and DWG read/write matrices and identifies OpenCADStudio and CADCraft as consumers. These declarations are source-level scope, not exact-artifact qualification or independent consumer evidence. OpenCADKernel's dependency and the existing plan's OpenCADStudio codec ancestry keep these routes correlated.

sources.name: ACadSharp current compatibility matrix and issue reports
sources.observed: The project publishes direction-specific DXF/DWG read/write version columns. Issue #1297 reports whole-file AC1032 AutoCAD rejection despite a reportedly byte-identical MTEXT object and leaves the suspected missing-style cause unproved. Issue #1282 reports a 32,768-byte signed-short overflow on one ACadSharp DWG writer path. These remain peer-only failure shapes; they do not establish local defects or normative format limits.

sources.name: IxMilia.Dxf current project scope
sources.observed: The README describes DXF/DXB rather than DWG support, declares R10 through R2014 DXF scope with entity exceptions, and lists AutoCAD writer-compatibility caveats. Use only for a pinned, targeted DXF comparison.

sources.name: GDAL stable DXF and ODA-dependent DWG driver documentation
sources.observed: The DXF driver documentation says Binary DXF input is supported starting with GDAL 3.12 and optional raw-code values expose unhandled tags; its OGR geometry and styling output is a projection. The distinct DWG driver depends on ODA and is read-only. Keep exact driver/backend/version attached to any optional observation.

sources.name: dwg-rs current empirical coverage reporting
sources.observed: The repository reports per-version decoded/skipped/errored counts over a small corpus, notes that aggregate percentage changed as the corpus grew, and describes self-validating record-boundary checks. Preserve corpus and per-version denominators when interpreting such measurements; do not compare aggregate percentages across changing corpora.

sources.name: LibreDWG current repository
sources.observed: The repository provides a separate open-source DWG/DXF implementation route; its result is still bound to exact revision, build options, operation, and license. No source was cloned or executable run in this review.

assessment.planImpact: Adds a current source-backed operation/route crosswalk and records OpenCADKernel as an early, correlated preservation-design candidate only. Sharpens the existing PAR-07/S8 composed evidence tuple to include source identity/owner path, raw modeler-carrier state/digest, AcDs association/closure, output identity/carrier, semantic outcome, and explicit disposition. Untouched unsupported payload remains preserved; dirty topology requires a proven exact re-emission route or atomic refusal. No new local finding, runtime, dependency, fixture, support claim, or routine validation work is added.

method.limitations: GitHub branch pages and issue reports are mutable. All observations are source/documentation-level and were not independently executed. OpenCADKernel is explicitly early and its dependency lineage is correlated with the OpenCADStudio/ACadRust route. GDAL is an OGR projection rather than a lossless CAD model. The research refines existing evidence gates but cannot promote format, semantic 3D, native-consumer, or J-item claims.
